executionAudit.finding: README instructs users to run opencood/tools/train_da.py, but that file is absent from the audited repository tree.
Inference requires a user-provided CHECKPOINT_FOLDER, while no checkpoint, release, tag, or verified download is exposed by the official repository.
Official issue 7 requests model checkpoints and camera-based assets; the open thread contains no verified maintainer asset or release.
The documented stack uses Python 3.7, PyTorch 1.12.0, CUDA 11.3, spconv 2.x, and locally compiled CUDA extensions.

candidateImpact.reason: The proposed no-fusion and intermediate-fusion checkpoint replay cannot start from verified official checkpoints. A replacement study must either train and fingerprint both models or use a different dataset with fixed public predictions.
V2X-Real may supply heterogeneous vehicle and infrastructure inputs after data access, but it cannot currently supply the pretrained comparator assumed by a short vertical slice.
Per-frame paired predictions must be generated by newly trained models or obtained from another fixed public asset.

allowedUse: Use the fixed source commit to inspect dataset, model, and evaluation contracts.
Use the official data entry after archive hashes and split manifests are frozen.
Train new baselines only if the study budget explicitly includes environment repair and training.
forbiddenUse: Do not describe official pretrained checkpoints as available.
Do not claim that the documented training command is runnable from the fixed commit.
Do not redistribute code or derivatives in conflict with the academic license.
Do not treat the unverified dataset download as a completed data audit.
recheckTriggers: An official checkpoint release or maintainer response appears.
The official repository adds the documented training entry point and a reproducible environment.
